scope: Fixed-view independent calibration-weight inspection loop only. Holds, raises, examines and lowers the same weight beside the empty balance pan; not weight placement, balance simulation, coin transfer, walking or other directions. Gameplay remains once-hold.

checks.identity-and-scale: All eight source and layered poses retain receding blond hair, brass-ended forked beard, olive waistcoat, cream sleeves and pouches; shared520px registration.
checks.station-and-foot-contact: Same independently rendered table and ground baseline. Both visible boots retain a stationary stance with small rendered pose variation; no separate skeletal sole-contact certification.
checks.hand-and-tool-contact: Right hand retains the brass cylinder by its knob in all eight poses, including tilted underside inspection. Left hand rests near the table edge. Per-frame foreground contours exclude vest/pouch fragments. The held cylinder stays beside the pan and is never released.
checks.prop-continuity: Table, empty pans, scale upright, open ledger, bag and spare weights remain unchanged through the action and departure. Actor does not include any table/scale pixels.
checks.last-to-first-transition: All eight layered poses and repeat/once-hold controls reviewed. Frame7 lowers weight close to initial ready0, without object or grip exchange; modest wrist movement closes the inspection cycle.
